nodes.description: External view function getBalances(address[] users, Token[] tokens) that loops over all user/token pairs, performs an external balanceOf call for each pair and returns a uint[] of balances.
Parameter 'users' (address[]) supplied by the caller; its length drives the outer loop and each element is passed as the argument of the external token call.
Parameter 'tokens' (Token[]) supplied by the caller; its length drives the inner loop and each element is the target contract of an external call.
Local variable cached from users.length, used as the outer loop bound and as an operand of the numUsers * numTokens multiplication.
Local variable cached from tokens.length, used as the inner loop bound and as an operand of the numUsers * numTokens multiplication.
Dynamically allocated memory array holding the balances returned by the external calls; it is returned to the caller.
Local index used to write into result via result[resultInd++]; incremented once per external call without any bounds check.
Outer loop counter iterating over the users array.
Inner loop counter iterating over the tokens array.
Computation new uint[](numUsers * numTokens); the multiplication of two caller-controlled lengths can overflow in Solidity 0.4.23, producing an undersized array and out-of-bounds writes.
External call tokens[tokenInd].balanceOf(users[userInd]) on a caller-supplied contract, executed inside a nested loop without checking the target or the call result.

edges.reason: users.length is read and stored in the local numUsers.
tokens.length is read and stored in the local numTokens.
numUsers is an operand of the numUsers * numTokens multiplication that sizes the result array, enabling integer overflow.
numTokens is an operand of the numUsers * numTokens multiplication that sizes the result array, enabling integer overflow.
The function body executes the multiplication used to allocate the result array.
Elements of the tokens array are used as the callee contract of the balanceOf external call.
Elements of the users array are passed as the address argument of the balanceOf external call.
tokenInd selects the array element tokens[tokenInd] used as the external call target.
userInd selects the array element users[userInd] used as the external call argument.
The nested loops inside getBalances drive the external balanceOf call.
The value returned by balanceOf is written into result[resultInd++].
resultInd is used as the write index into result; unchecked increment can lead to out-of-bounds array access when the array size is miscalculated.
The result array is returned by getBalances.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter users is only a pass-through source for the address argument of the external balanceOf call and can be absorbed into that operation node.
The parameter tokens is only a pass-through source for the callee contract of the external balanceOf call and can be absorbed into that operation node.
numUsers is a temporary cache of users.length used solely as an operand of the multiplication sizing the result array.
numTokens is a temporary cache of tokens.length used solely as an operand of the multiplication sizing the result array.
resultInd is the internal write cursor advanced once per external balanceOf call and is meaningful only in that loop context.
userInd is only the outer loop counter selecting the argument of the external balanceOf call.
tokenInd is only the inner loop counter selecting the target of the external balanceOf call.
